# Swarm wire protocol v1 golden frames (docs/design/agent-swarm.md §11.2).
# Shared by the Java codec (FrameTest) and the Python SDK (sdk/python/tests/test_frames.py).
# name type flags payload-hex frame-hex   ("-" = empty payload)
task-empty TASK 0 - 010100000000
claim-small CLAIM 0 7375 0102000000027375
token-last TOKEN 1 6869 0106010000026869
cancel CANCEL 0 - 010800000000
# credit-1024 is a frame-level vector (opaque payload), unchanged. It is not a CREDIT payload v1; golden-credit-v1.txt uses it as a negative vector (#247).
credit-1024 CREDIT 0 00000400 01090000000400000400
result-last-error RESULT 5 6f6f7073 0105050000046f6f7073
error-200 ERROR 0  
extend EXTEND 0 000000000000000700000002 01040000000c000000000000000700000002
lease LEASE 0 01 01030000000101
# TASK frames carrying a v1 task envelope (§4.5) whose replyTo holds NUL / a supplementary character.
# Text fields are STANDARD UTF-8: NUL is 00 (not c080), U+1F600 is f09f9880 (not a CESU-8 surrogate pair).
task-env-nul TASK 0 01111111111111111111111111111111112222222222222222222222222222222200000000000003e8000b7265706c792e6e756c0078000000000000000a746578742f706c61696e000000026869 01010000004e01111111111111111111111111111111112222222222222222222222222222222200000000000003e8000b7265706c792e6e756c0078000000000000000a746578742f706c61696e000000026869
task-env-emoji TASK 0 01111111111111111111111111111111112222222222222222222222222222222200000000000003e8000a7265706c792ef09f9880000000000000000a746578742f706c61696e000000026869 01010000004d01111111111111111111111111111111112222222222222222222222222222222200000000000003e8000a7265706c792ef09f9880000000000000000a746578742f706c61696e000000026869
